name: Plausible Analytics
summary: Plausible Analytics does not support OAuth 2.0 for third-party application integration. Integrations must use team-scoped API keys (Bearer tokens) manually generated by users within their Plausible account settings.

decideFirst.question: How should your application connect to user accounts without OAuth 2.0?
decideFirst.guidance: Plausible Analytics does not provide an OAuth 2.0 framework or consent flow for third-party applications. Collect a team-scoped API key directly from the user and authenticate all API requests via HTTP Bearer tokens.

evidence.note: Plausible API documentation specifies API keys sent as Bearer tokens as the sole authentication mechanism.

decideFirst.question: Which API key scope does your integration require?
decideFirst.guidance: Determine if your app only queries analytics data (Stats API key) or needs to create and manage sites, goals, and guest users (Sites API key). Note that full Sites API management requires an Enterprise plan, while read-only site endpoints work with a Stats API key on any plan supporting Stats API.

evidence.note: Stats API requires a Business plan; write operations on Sites API require an Enterprise plan.

phases.name: 1 · Obtain Team API Key
phases.goal: Have the user generate a team-scoped API key in their Plausible settings.

steps.title: Select Team and Navigate to API Keys
steps.detail: Ask the user to log in to Plausible Analytics, select the target team in the top-right menu, click their account name to open settings, and navigate to the API Keys section.

steps.title: Create and Copy API Key
steps.detail: The user clicks 'New API Key', selects either 'Stats API' or 'Sites API', confirms creation, and copies the API token to enter into your application.

phases.name: 2 · Make Authenticated Requests
phases.goal: Configure your application HTTP client to use Bearer token authentication.

steps.title: Set Authorization Header
steps.detail: Pass the user-provided key in the HTTP request header formatted as 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' when calling endpoints such as POST https://plausible.io/api/v2/query or GET https://plausible.io/api/v1/sites.

requirements.item: Plausible Account with Owner, Admin, Editor, or Billing Role
requirements.requiredFor: Generating Stats or Sites API keys
requirements.note: Users with Viewer, Guest Viewer, or Guest Editor roles cannot generate API keys for team sites.
Stats API requires a Business plan. Full site management write endpoints require an Enterprise plan.

blockers.symptom: HTTP 401/403 or missing site data when querying Stats API
blockers.cause: The API key was created under a team that does not own the target site, or the user who created the key is only a Guest member on the target site.
blockers.fix: The API key must be created under the team that owns the site. Keys cannot query sites owned by another team or sites where the key creator is a guest.

blockers.symptom: Server-side events return HTTP 202 Accepted but are dropped from analytics reports
blockers.cause: Plausible bot filtering dropped the event because X-Forwarded-For contained a server or CDN IP address rather than the end-user's IP address.
blockers.fix: Forward the actual visitor's IP in X-Forwarded-For (or CF-Connecting-IP) and forward the visitor's User-Agent. Debug by sending a test request with 'X-Debug-Request: true' to check the resolved IP.

nuances.title: No Third-Party OAuth 2.0 Support
nuances.detail: Plausible Analytics does not provide an OAuth 2.0 server for third-party integrations (no Client ID, Client Secret, or authorization redirect flow). User SSO features (Google, Entra ID, Okta) are solely for user login into Plausible.

nuances.title: API Key Invalidation on Team Membership Change
nuances.detail: API keys inherit access from the team member who created them. If the key owner leaves or is removed from the team, the API key loses access to that team's sites immediately.

nuances.title: Stats API Rate Limits
nuances.detail: The Stats API enforces a default rate limit of 600 requests per hour per key.
